messages:
joel: Quick sync for cloud marketplace onboarding: need onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure + a minimal manifest for publishers. Goal: staging ingest by next Tue. Who can take what?

maria: I can do packaging (assets + manifest). Will produce hero, screenshots, quickstart, and a terraform example. Any constraints on file sizes or image formats?

raj: I'll handle infra side: cross-account roles, KMS per-region, and bucket policies. Need publisher account IDs and if they want public or private trial bundles.

joel: Publisher wants private trial bundles for now. Publisher IDs incoming via email. Also need legal input on trial T&Cs and telemetry.

maria: Draft manifest idea:```json
{
  "id": "redwood-inference-pro",
  "sku": "rw-infer-pro-1",
  "version": "2026-03-23",
  "trial_days": "14",
  "assets": ["hero.jpg","quickstart.md","terraform.tf"],
  "regions": ["us-west-2","europe-west1"],
  "notes": "private-trial"
}
```

raj: infra checklist: create S3 staging bucket, KMS key in each region, cross-account role with limited PutObject to prefix /ingest/, and lifecycle policy to auto-delete after 30 days. I'll post CLI snippets in infra repo.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for pub-onboard-bundle #7621 - queued.

legal-bot: Reminder: any telemetry that could be linked to a person requires DPA review. Use aggregated metrics by default.

joel: Action items: maria -> manifest + asset pack (ETA: Thu). raj -> infra + KMS policy (ETA: Fri). legal -> T&Cs and DPA check (ETA: Fri). I'll compile a single tracker doc and send invite for a brief Monday demo.

maria: Will include sample terraform that demonstrates role assumption and asset upload.

raj: Added lifecycle policy draft. Ping me the publisher IDs when you have them.

joel: Thanks — ping here if anything blocks.
